title: Louis Messina, Andy Kirk and Tex's archive donation
summary: Tex recalls promoter Louis Messina bringing in Andy Kirk's Clouds of Joy, and says he gave recordings to the Tulane archive.

bands.name: Andy Kirk and His Clouds of Joy

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: That's right. That's a collector's item. In other words, Ted, you and me are sitting down here talking about history, the way it was and the way it should be. And for some particular reason, you still at that time had an element of people did not want to see progress between blacks and whites. You know, when I think back, had it not been for Louis Messina, there would not have been whites and blacks fighting against each other at the Coliseum Arena. Louis Messina was one of the great promoters who operated the Gypsy Tea Room. He was the guy who first time brought in, I'm thinking about this man here, Andy Kirk and it's Clouds of Joy. And you talk about a band. Wow, boy. You know, I still have some of those recordings. I don't know if you ever heard them. Sure.
I imagine you have some here.

Yep. Some of my collections, I brought them to Dr. Rayburn to put into the archives that will live forever around here. So, like I said, we have done some things that I really feel proud of that I had lived at a time in history for the growth of the city of New Orleans in the greater metropolitan area where some positive things have been done between whites and blacks collectively, you know, because we...
